prompt: Stage 2-6, level 5, 21 gold, 92 HP. Next round is 2-7, the monster round: it drops loot (components or gold) when the monsters die. Someone tells you to refresh the shop now so you are sure to beat the monsters. Your five units are all 2-stars. What do you do?

options.label: Hold: five 2-stars clear the stage-2 monsters easily and the loot drops either way. Keep the 21 and pass 30 with next round's income for another interest gold
Refresh 10 gold to strengthen the board so you do not lose the items to the monsters
Buy XP to level 6 so a sixth unit helps against the monsters

explanation:
Monster rounds are where items come from, and the stage-2 monsters are weak: any board that fields its units kills them, and yours is five 2-stars. The loot drops as the monsters die and is yours to pick up. Spending gold to 'make sure' is spending against a problem that does not exist. Hold the 21: income at 2-7 takes you past 30, which is 3 interest a round going into stage 3 instead of 2.

Refreshing 10 gold buys nothing you need and drops you to 11 gold, 1 interest. Buying XP for a sixth unit makes even less sense: level 6 costs 8 gold here and the standard time for it is 3-2, when the augment round gives you a reason. The monster round is a free round; treat it as one. The only time to worry about a monster round is late in the game when a weak board can actually fail to kill everything, and then the fix is fielding your full board, not refreshing.
principle: Monster rounds are free loot: field your units, kill the monsters, keep your gold.
commonMistake: Refreshing or levelling 'for the monsters' at 2-6 and entering stage 3 with half the interest you should have.
hint: Ask whether your board can actually lose to stage-2 monsters, and what 21 gold becomes after next round's income if you spend nothing.
